identity.title: Identity
identity.slugHint: The URL segment in your public site. Changing this breaks existing links.
identity.descriptionPlaceholder: Short tagline + the gist of the place.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Logo and cover image shown on the public site.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: How customers reach you and where receipts come from.

location.title: Location
location.description: Coordinates power the customer map, delivery-zone checks, and search results.
location.prompt: Click the map or use Locate me to set a location.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description: Shapes how the restaurant appears in search results, AI answers, and social previews.
discovery.cuisineHint: Comma-separated, e.g. "Polish, Middle Eastern". Drives schema.org servesCuisine.
discovery.priceRangeHint: Shown in Google rich results and map cards. Enter a range like "20–40 zł" or a tier ($–$$$$).
discovery.sameAsHint: One URL per line — Facebook, Instagram, Google Business, etc. Emitted as schema.org sameAs.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Per-channel acceptance — gates the public site without unpublishing the restaurant.
channels.publishedHint: Show on the customer site at all.
channels.estimatedTimeHint: Shown to customers as an indicative range (e.g. 30–45 min). Leave both blank to hide.

rangeError.incomplete: Set both a min and a max, or leave both blank.
rangeError.order: Minimum must be less than or equal to maximum.

legal.title: Legal entity
legal.description: Official company identity used on invoices, the payment provider, and your legal pages.
legal.verifyWarning: These values must match your KRS, Stripe, and payout-bank records exactly. Verify against an official current KRS extract before entering — the app does not check external registries.
legal.legalNameHint: Exact registered company name (e.g. "… SPÓŁKA Z OGRANICZONĄ ODPOWIEDZIALNOŚCIĄ"), not the brand name.
legal.krsHint: 10 digits. Leave blank for sole traders / non-KRS forms.
legal.registryCourtHint: Court and division, e.g. "Sąd Rejonowy w Kielcach, X Wydział Gospodarczy KRS".
legal.registeredSameLabel: Registered address same as trading address
legal.registeredSameHint: Turn off to enter a separate registered (KRS) address.

payments.title: Payments & customer support
payments.description: Support channels shown to customers and the expected card statement descriptor.
payments.statementDescriptorHint: 5–22 characters shown on card statements (letters/numbers/spaces; no < > \ ' " *).

readiness.title: Payment provider readiness
readiness.complete: All required legal & support fields are filled. This does not verify your data against external registries.
readiness.incompleteHint: Fill these required fields before enabling online payments:
